json.title: Database commit() called without await
json.reason: A promise-returning API (db.commit()) is invoked as a bare statement, so its rejection/completion is not awaited before the function returns — a syntactically detectable floating-promise bug that can recur anywhere commit() is used.
json.message: `commit()` result is not awaited: the transaction may fail or finish after the response is sent.
json.note: db.commit() returns a promise; calling it as a bare statement lets the enclosing async function return (and the HTTP response be sent) before the commit settles, silently dropping writes when it rejects. Add `await` (or `return`) so failures propagate.
json.rule_yaml:
rule:
  pattern: $DB.commit($$$ARGS)
  kind: call_expression
  inside:
    kind: expression_statement
  not:
    inside:
      any:
        - kind: await_expression
        - kind: return_statement
  inside:
    stopBy: end
    any:
      - kind: function_declaration
      - kind: arrow_function
      - kind: method_definition
      - kind: function_expression
    regex: "^(async |.*\\basync\\b)"
